description: Official product-image rules of a marketplace or ad platform such as Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Shopify, Walmart, TikTok Shop or Google Shopping (size, file size, formats, main-image background and fill), each read from the platform's own help page, with the source and the day it was read. Omit platform to list all platforms. It does not test an image: with a photo link use check_image_url, with known dimensions use check_image_spec.

platform.description: Platform key, for example amazon, ebay, etsy, shopify, google-shopping, zalando. Omit to list every platform.

name: get_image_requirements

outputSchema.description: Without a platform: platforms. With a platform: that platform's rules.

checked.description: Day the official page was read (YYYY-MM-DD).

kind.description: marketplace (marketplaces and shop platforms) or specs (ad platforms and other image specifications).

limits.description: Numeric limits; null means the platform publishes no such limit, not that anything is allowed.

aspect_ratio.description: Required aspect ratio as published, for example 1:1 or 1:1.44.

formats.description: Accepted file formats, lower case (jpeg, png, …).

max_file_mb.description: Maximum file size in decimal megabytes.

max_side_px.description: Maximum length of any side, in pixels.

min_long_side_px.description: Minimum length of the longest side, in pixels.

min_side_px.description: Minimum length of the shorter side, in pixels.

zoom_min_side_px.description: Shorter side needed for the platform's zoom, in pixels.

main_image.description: Main-image rules; null when the platform publishes none.

applies_to.description: Product group the main-image rules apply to, when the platform limits them.

background.description: Required background: pure-white (RGB 255), white, light or uniform.

crop_safe.description: The product must survive square, portrait and landscape crops.

fill_max.description: Maximum share of the frame the product covers, 0 to 1.

fill_min.description: Minimum share of the frame the product covers on its longest axis, 0 to 1.

recommended_only.description: True when the main-image rules are recommendations, not requirements.

source_url.description: Official page of the main-image rules, when it differs from source_url.

square.description: The main image must be square.

whole_product.description: The whole product must be in the frame, nothing cut off.

platforms.description: Every platform; present only when no platform was given.

key.description: Platform key to pass as platform.

kind.description: marketplace (marketplaces and shop platforms) or specs (ad platforms and other image specifications).

rules.description: The published rules as [rule name, rule text] pairs, as in Herofab's guide.

source_url.description: The platform's own help page the rules were read from.

summary.description: One-line summary of the size rules.

title: Marketplace image requirements
